## What this changes

## For a new task

- [ ] `task ci` is green
- [ ] The stub compiles and vets clean, and its tests fail
- [ ] `_solution/` is sealed (`undergo seal <id>`) and not committed
- [ ] `HINT.md` names the mechanism, not the answer
- [ ] `inspired_by:` records where the idea came from
- [ ] `requires:` declares any architecture or Go-version dependence
- [ ] No frozen test was weakened
